name: dealproof
description: AI diligence red team for VC and PE deal materials.

scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:backend && npm run build
scripts.clean: rm -rf .next test-results playwright-report coverage generated_reports backend/.pytest_cache backend/app/__pycache__ backend/tests/__pycache__ backend/storage backend/data tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv run python -m pytest
scripts.fixtures:real: cd backend && uv run python scripts/fetch_real_cases.py
